en: Weapon class bonuses are doubled. Their drawbacks are not
Weapon class level comes from the total weapon tiers you own in that class: 1 level per 4 tiers, up to 6
Combine two weapons of the same tier sharing a class into a random weapon of that class one tier higher. At max tier, combine into a different max-tier weapon instead
Weapons come in 8 tiers instead of 4
